The layoffs reflect broader tech industry trends that have seen companies aggressively trim headcount to fund automation investments and satisfy investor demands for profitability. ## Impact on Operations The 260 affected employees span multiple departments, with the heaviest cuts falling in areas where AI automation now handles core functions. Engineering teams focused on legacy infrastructure were also affected as the company consolidates resources around its next-generation AI product suite.
